title: BiHeat 0.1.0
text: First release. biheat() draws two matrices shape one heatmap, splitting every cell along diagonal. breed(), incubate() plot() expose drawing three-stage lifecycle around clutch object, carries aligned matrices, tidy long form, comparison statistics. switch_sides(), straighten(), bothways() comes_out() operate clutch-, clutch-. geom_biheat() draws split cells ggplot2 layer. triangle carries gradient, leaving fill scale free layers. bi_legend() returns paired-palette key standalone grob. palettes() bundles pair gradient palettes; theme_biheat() supplies minimal heatmap theme. Three vignettes: vignette("biheat") clutch, alignment, lifecycle, vignette("styling") rendering options, vignette("geom-biheat") ggplot2 layer.
